item.text: {"summary":"Draft is publishable only after tightening the resolver/fallback and replacing the hand-waved model and interval with an explicit historical or uncertainty basis.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"warning","summary":"Resolver names CMS and the field, but the first-print rule lacks a fallback if no April 2026 updated national file is posted by 2026-09-30 and does not name the exact table/file field as precisely as possible.","actionRequested":"Specify the exact CMS/data.Medicaid.gov file or dataset/table and column to use, and add a clear fallback rule for no qualifying updated April 2026 file by 2026-09-30."},{"rubricItem":"model_prior","severity":"blocking","summary":"The draft does not use a time-series/model prior and does not explicitly rule one out; it only anchors on March 2026 and applies judgmental adjustments.","actionRequested":"Add a stated model prior, such as recent month-over-month changes in the same CMS updated series, or explicitly justify why a time-series prior is unavailable or inappropriate."},{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"blocking","summary":"The 80% interval is described as 'wider' and about +/-1.45 million but is not tied to realized volatility, recent revision error, or a calibrated uncertainty assumption.","actionRequested":"Derive the interval from historical month-over-month volatility, preliminary-to-updated revision history, or a stated quantitative uncertainty model."},{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"warning","summary":"The -0.20 million attrition and +0.06 million updated-vintage adjustment are plausible but not tied to observed recent changes or revision magnitudes.","actionRequested":"Tie these adjustments to recent CMS monthly movement and/or preliminary-to-updated differences, or label them explicitly as judgmental assumptions."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Quote the March 2026 CMS level as the persistence prior before the adjusted point calculation.","Make the tail scenarios numeric, for example what monthly drop or retroactive revision would be needed to breach each interval bound.","Check that '50 states and DC' matches the exact national total used by CMS and excludes territories if CMS publishes separate territory rows."]}
